# Loss functions

**Explained in:** [Loss functions and class imbalance](../../training/losses.md)

This page documents **16 public classes and functions** in 4 modules.

## `pygeovision.losses.segmentation`

Geospatial segmentation losses (D1) — pure PyTorch, fully native.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `DiceLoss` | class | Dice loss for semantic segmentation. |
| `FocalLoss` | class | Focal loss — down-weights easy/well-classified examples. |
| `TverskyLoss` | class | Tversky loss — generalised Dice with separate FP/FN penalties. |
| `ComboLoss` | class | Combo loss = weighted Dice + weighted CE. |
| `WeightedSumLoss` | class | Weighted sum of losses, e.g. focal + dice for a rare class. |
| `BoundaryAwareLoss` | class | Boundary-aware loss — adds extra penalty at object edges. |
| `OhemCrossEntropy` | class | Online Hard Example Mining Cross-Entropy (OHEM). |
| `LovaszLoss` | class | Lovász-Softmax loss — convex surrogate for the IoU metric. |
| `GeospatialMixedLoss` | class | Production-ready composite loss for geospatial segmentation. |

## `pygeovision.losses.detection`

IoU-family losses for object detection (D1).

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `CIoULoss` | class | Complete IoU loss — accounts for overlap, distance, and aspect ratio. |
| `DIoULoss` | class | Distance IoU loss — penalises center-point distance on top of IoU, without CIoU's additional aspect-ratio term. |
| `GIoULoss` | class | Generalised IoU loss. |

## `pygeovision.losses.class_balance`

Class-balancing losses for imbalanced geospatial datasets (D2).

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `ClassBalancedCrossEntropy` | class | Cross-entropy with class-frequency-based weight balancing. |
| `LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy` | class | Cross-entropy with label smoothing — reduces overconfidence. |
| `FocalCrossEntropy` | class | Focal loss implemented as a cross-entropy variant. |
